The '''asteroid tug tractor beam''' was a large, powerful [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] that was mounted on the hulls of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. In [[36 ABY]], several [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], including the [[Admiral Ackbar (Victory-class)|''Admiral Ackbar'']], had been outfitted with these devices, which had been supplied to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] by [[Tendrando Arms]]. These vessels were designated as [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] hunters. Several vessels utilizing these tractor beams assisted in the recapture of the ''Admiral Ackbar'' from [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] forces during the [[Battle of Tenupe]].

The [[Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug]] ''[[Rockhound]]'', operated by Tendrando Arms' owner, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], was equipped with many tractor beam emitters that he used to offset the gravitational pull of surrounding [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] during the joint [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] into [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]].<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>
